title: Dahuang Gancao decoction suppresses ferroptosis via SIRT3-mediated NRF2 deacetylation in acute kidney injury.
authors: Cui, Mengdi; An, Yi; Zhao, Jingling; Hui, Miaoxin; Xiong, Zhili; Guan, Bing; Shen, Yinfeng; Zou, Yinshui; Li, Chengyin; Wang, Rui
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药大黄甘草汤通过SIRT3介导NRF2去乙酰化抑制急性肾损伤中的铁死亡，仅涉及SIRT3与小分子的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is a leading complication of sepsis, necessitating the exploration of novel treatment modalities. The traditional Chinese medicine Dahuang Gancao Decoction (DHGC) has potential in the treatment of sepsis-associated acute kidney injury (SA-AKI). However, its specific mechanisms require further investigation. PURPOSE: This study aimed to validate the antiferroptotic effects of DHGC in the treatment of SA-AKI in vivo and in vitro. METHODS: C57BL/6 mice and C57BL/6-background sirtuin-3 (SIRT3)(-/-) mice were induced with lipopolysaccharide (LPS), while normal and si-SIRT3 human proximal tubular epithelial (HK-2) cells were induced with erastin to establish a ferroptosis phenotype, followed by DHGC treatment. First, the DHGC components were identified via liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC‒MS/MS), and the potential active components were further screened through comparison with the high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) reference standards. Ferroptosis levels and the protective mechanisms of DHGC in vivo and in vitro were evaluated using biochemical assays, transmission electron microscopy (TEM), immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence, and Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8) assays. Key pathways were identified by RNA-seq and validated via enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and Western blotting. Finally, the potential active components were subjected to molecular docking with SIRT3 to select candidate monomers for subsequent in vitro functional validation. RESULTS: LPS was used to induce SA-AKI in mice, and erastin was used to induce ferroptosis in HK-2 cells. DHGC improved renal function, increase cell viability, and reverse abnormal changes in key ferroptosis indicators. Mechanistically, the expression levels of SIRT3/nuclear factor erythroid-2 related factor 2 (NRF2) pathway-associated proteins were downregulated, and NRF2 nuclear translocation was restricted after modeling; in contrast, DHGC upregulated the expression of SIRT3/NRF2 pathway-related proteins, promoted NRF2 nuclear translocation, and activated downstream glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) expression. Importantly, DHGC failed to improve the above indicators in SIRT3-deficient models. Potential active components of DHGC were screened via HPLC reference standard comparison, and subsequent molecular docking with SIRT3 identified candidate monomers. These monomers exerted ferroptosis-inhibiting effects consistent with those of the parent compound DHGC. CONCLUSIONS: The present study offers the first demonstration that DHGC retards SA-AKI progression through stimulating SIRT3-driven deacetylation of NRF2, promoting NRF2 nuclear translocation, and inhibiting ferroptosis. These findings suggest that DHGC is a potential therapeutic candidate for SA-AKI, warranting further clinical investigation.
abstract_zh: 背景：急性肾损伤（AKI）是脓毒症的主要并发症，亟需探索新的治疗方式。中药大黄甘草汤（DHGC）在治疗脓毒症相关急性肾损伤（SA-AKI）方面具有潜力，但其具体机制需进一步研究。目的：本研究旨在体内和体外验证DHGC治疗SA-AKI的抗铁死亡效应。方法：以脂多糖（LPS）诱导C57BL/6小鼠及C57BL/6背景的sirtuin-3（SIRT3）基因敲除小鼠，同时以erastin诱导正常及si-SIRT3人肾近端小管上皮（HK-2）细胞建立铁死亡表型，随后进行DHGC处理。首先，通过液相色谱-串联质谱（LC‒MS/MS）鉴定DHGC成分，并通过与高效液相色谱（HPLC）参考标准品比对进一步筛选潜在活性成分。采用生化检测、透射电子显微镜（TEM）、免疫组织化学、免疫荧光及细胞计数试剂盒-8（CCK-8）实验评估体内外铁死亡水平及DHGC的保护机制。通过RNA-seq识别关键通路，并利用酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）和蛋白质印迹法进行验证。最后，将潜在活性成分与SIRT3进行分子对接，以筛选候选单体用于后续体外功能验证。结果：采用LPS诱导小鼠SA-AKI，erastin诱导HK-2细胞铁死亡。DHGC改善了肾功能、提高了细胞活力，并逆转了关键铁死亡指标的异常变化。机制上，建模后SIRT3/核因子E2相关因子2（NRF2）通路相关蛋白表达下调，NRF2核转位受限；相反，DHGC上调了SIRT3/NRF2通路相关蛋白的表达，促进NRF2核转位，并激活下游谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）的表达。重要的是，在SIRT3缺陷模型中，DHGC未能改善上述指标。通过HPLC参考标准品比对筛选出DHGC的潜在活性成分，随后与SIRT3的分子对接确定了候选单体。这些单体发挥的铁死亡抑制作用与母体化合物DHGC一致。结论：本研究首次证明DHGC通过刺激SIRT3驱动的NRF2去乙酰化、促进NRF2核转位及抑制铁死亡来延缓SA-AKI进展。这些发现表明DHGC是SA-AKI的潜在治疗候选药物，值得进一步临床研究。
